acceptedInterpretation: Enforcement FLOOR only: pin verification:{command,selector} on the intent (added on first evidence write, immutable), route BOTH verification_evidence_add and verification_evidence_batch_add through one shared enforce-and-stamp helper that executes the pinned command via the existing executor and refuses on exit!=0-but-pass / selector-absent / intentRef-unresolved / command-mismatch, stamp a receipt (exitCode/outputDigest/outputTail) with result derived from the exit, demote manual|docs in buildVerificationCoverage so they cannot cover an executable intent, and grandfather legacy prose-only evidence. Excludes verification_run + PreToolUse seatbelt (①b), refresh_stale (B-3b88), Step 3/4.
notes: Chosen over a bare expectedCommand field (insufficient; still trusts result) and over shipping only verification_run (leaves the trusted add-path open). Reuses executor + receipt shape + allowlist.
